vision.name: Orange Energetic Mastery
vision.text:
(At the start of your opponent's first turn, search your Life Deck for a Styled non-[Continuous] Drill and place it into play.)
[Instant] POWER: Use after performing a successful attack. Gain 3 stages and raise your anger 1.
POWER: Discard a card from your hand to perform a Styled energy attack dealing 4 life cards of damage. If you discarded a Styled card, raise or lower a player's anger 1.
